arxiv-1901-08942.title: Improving Image Captioning by Leveraging Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-1901-08942.creator: Yimin Zhou, Yiwei Sun, Vasant Honavar
arxiv-1901-08942.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Yimin Zhou, Yiwei Sun, Vasant Honavar. We explore the use of a knowledge graphs, that capture general or commonsense knowledge, to augment the information extracted from images by the state-of-the-art methods for image captioning.

arxiv-2210-12022.title: Performance-Efficiency Trade-Offs in Adapting Language Models to Text Classification Tasks
arxiv-2210-12022.creator: Laura Aina, Nikos Voskarides, Roi Blanco
arxiv-2210-12022.description: Abstract Pre-trained language models (LMs) obtain state-of-the-art performance when adapted to text classification tasks. However, when using such models in real-world applications, efficiency considerations are paramount. In this paper, we study how different training procedures that adapt LMs to text classification perform, as we vary model and train set size.

arxiv-2312-11316.title: Physics Informed Neural Networks for an Inverse Problem in Peridynamic Models
arxiv-2312-11316.creator: Fabio V. Difonzo, Luciano Lopez, Sabrina F. Pellegrino
arxiv-2312-11316.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fabio V. Difonzo, Luciano Lopez, Sabrina F. Pellegrino. Deep learning is a powerful tool for solving data driven differential problems and has come out to have successful applications in solving direct and inverse problems described by PDEs, even in presence of integral terms.

arxiv-2407-05958.title: Leveraging collective effects for thermometry in waveguide quantum electrodynamics
arxiv-2407-05958.creator: Aleksei Sharafiev 1, Mathieu Juan 2, Marco Cattaneo 3, Gerhard Kirchmair 1,4
arxiv-2407-05958.description: Abstract We report a proof-of-principle experiment for a new method of temperature measurements in waveguide quantum electrodynamics (wQED) experiments, allowing one to differentiate between global and local baths. The method takes advantage of collective states of two transmon qubits located in the center of a waveguide.

arxiv-2507-16487.title: Longitudinal Structure Function at the Limit x = Q 2 / s x=Q^{2}/s
arxiv-2507-16487.creator: G. R. Boroun
arxiv-2507-16487.description: Abstract The longitudinal structure function for nucleons and nuclei is considered at fixed s \sqrt{s} and Q 2 Q^{2} to the minimum value of x x given by Q 2 / s Q^{2}/s . This is done using the expansion method and color dipole model in the next-to-leading order approximation.

pmc-11536337.title: Clutch attendance and call parameters are linked to mating success in a glassfrog with paternal care
pmc-11536337.creator: Marina Garrido-Priego, Moric Tószeghi, Francesca N Angiolani-Larrea, Anyelet Valencia-Aguilar, Lauriane Bégué, Raby Núñez, Jaime Culebras, Max Ringler, Jennifer L Stynoski, Eva Ringler, Mark Briffa
pmc-11536337.description: Females of some species improve their reproductive success not only by being choosy and selecting males with certain traits, but also by sequentially mating with multiple males within one reproductive season. However, it is relatively unknown whether females also evaluate parental care during mate choice and, if they do, whether males actively communicate their care status to approaching females.

pmc-11810910.title: I’ve just seen a face: further search for face pareidolia in chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes)
pmc-11810910.creator: Masaki Tomonaga
pmc-11810910.description: IntroductionSeeing faces in random patterns, such as in clouds, is known as pareidolia. Two possible mechanisms can cause pareidolia: a bottom-up mechanism that automatically detects inverted triangle or top-heavy patterns, and a top-down mechanism that actively seeks out faces. Pareidolia has been reported in nonhuman animals as well.

pmc-12430050.title: Maternal Folate Excess, Placental Hormones, and Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: Findings from Prospective Cohorts Before and After Mandatory Folic Acid Food Fortification
pmc-12430050.creator: Tanja Jankovic-Karasoulos, Melanie D Smith, Shalem Leemaqz, Murthy Mittinty, Jessica Williamson, Dylan McCullough, Anya L Arthurs, Gustaaf A Dekker, Claire T Roberts, Ornoy Asher
pmc-12430050.description: Background/Objectives: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) prevalence in Australia has increased from 5.6% (2010) to 19.3% (2022), coinciding with the introduction of mandatory folic acid (FA) food fortification and increased supplementation. Animal studies show that high FA intake in pregnancy impairs maternal glucose regulation, but the underlying mechanisms are unknown.

pmc-12744225.title: Impact of Holism Based Blended Learning Model on Medical Immunology Among Traditional Chinese Medicine Students: A Comparative Survey Study
pmc-12744225.creator: Yanchao Ma, Bin Wang, Yuzhu Jiang, Qizhi Cao, Tao Hu, Xiying Luan
pmc-12744225.description: ObjectiveDue the concept of medical immunology is abstract and difficult to align with the “holism and balance of Yin and Yang” in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), students feel intimidated and have weak identification with it. This study has constructed a “holism-based blended teaching model” and verified its promoting effect on knowledge, grades, and professional identification.MethodsA cross-sectional study design was adopted.

pmc-12752428.title: Application of generative artificial intelligence chatbots + project task driven teaching in undergraduate nursing students: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-12752428.creator: Jing Shi, Xinjin Li, Yanhua Ning, Weijuan Kong, Wenqin Guo, Tiantian Ma, Ning Yang, Jianjiao Lu, Yahong Guo, Lingna Liu, Cailin Yang
pmc-12752428.description: BackgroundGenerative artificial intelligence chatbots have become increasingly popular in the nursing education. Numerous academics have integrated them into their courses to assess the effects of artificial intelligence-supported teaching method. However, few researches have examined the impact of generative artificial intelligence chatbots in nursing education in conjunction with a particular teaching methodology.

pmc-13218532.title: Semigroup-theoretic analysis of supply-chain disruptions and resilience
pmc-13218532.creator: Job Agba Opue, Marshal I. Sampson, Otobong J. Tom, Uchechukwu E. Okorie, Fucai Lin, Fucai Lin, Fucai Lin
pmc-13218532.description: This paper develops a rigorous framework using finite transformation semigroups to model supply-chain state evolution under cascading disruptions and resilience interventions. Disruptions and interventions are represented as non-invertible transformations on finite configuration spaces, generating a semigroup whose structure encodes collapse conditions, equilibria, minimal collapse-inducing sets, and redundancy.

pmc-13551031.title: Enhancing prediction accuracy for enzyme activity engineering through sequence co-evolution and epistatic relationship modeling
pmc-13551031.creator: Da Neub Kim, Hyeongseop Kim, Donghyo Kim, Gyoo Yeol Jung, Sanguk Kim, Myung Hyun Noh
pmc-13551031.description: Conventional enzyme engineering strategies, such as directed evolution with structure-based analysis, are limited by laborious workflows and by the need to screen extensive enzyme libraries. Computational models based on multiple sequence alignment, such as SCANEER, have streamlined these engineering strategies, enabling the successful prediction of single-site mutations that enhance enzyme activity.

(a) In General.— The corporation shall have the sole and exclusive right to use the names “National American Indian Veterans, Incorporated” and “National American Indian Veterans”, and such seals, emblems, and badges as the corporation.
